paper_title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners A Comprehensive   Evaluation and Beyond
caption: Visualization on the metric of answer correctness.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different models across various reasoning tasks. The horizontal axes contain the categories, with one axis labeled with the models "Davinci-003," "ChatGPT," and "BARD," and the other axis with the task types "Inductive," "Abductive," "Deductive," and "Mix." The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0 to 0.8 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each bar is colored with a gradient from blue at the bottom to yellow at the top. The bars for each model-task combination are arranged in a 3D matrix format, showing the accuracy for "Inductive," "Abductive," "Deductive," and "Mix" tasks. The approximate accuracy values range from around 0.2 for some of the shorter bars to near 1 for the taller bars. "Davinci-003" model with "Deductive" task has the highest accuracy, comparable with "BARD" model's accuracy under the same task, and "ChatGPT" with "Inductive" task has the lowest accuracy. Bars do not appear to be sorted in any specific order beyond the given labels, and no bars are visually emphasized with additional shading or outlines.
